name: Huntmaster Procyon
description: A Zendikari hunter who works with the Outsider to uncover the hedron corruption.

description_citations.text: "The Traveler". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Procyon and the Outsider discover the merfolk are corrupting the hedron grid.
timeline.quote: Procyon and the Outsider discovered that the merfolk were corrupting the entire hedron grid using water elementals, causing the wildlife and locals to become unnaturally aggressive.
